sn12.65:1.2: Pubbe me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etad ahosi || ||
sn12.65:1.3: Kicchaṃ vatāyaṃ loko āpanno jāyati ca jīyate ca mīyati ca cavati ca upapajjati ca ||
sn12.65:1.4: atha ca panimassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ na pajānāti jarāmaraṇassa ||
sn12.65:1.5: Kudāssu nāma imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyissati jarāmaraṇassā ti || || 3
sn12.65:1.7: Kimhi nu kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti kimpaccayā jarāmaraṇanti || || 4
sn12.65:1.8: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo || ||
sn12.65:1.9: Jātiyā kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti || jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇanti || || 5
sn12.65:2.2: Kimhi nu kho sati jāti hoti ||
sn12.65:2.11: Tassa mayham bhikkhave yonīso manasikārā ahu paññāya ābhisamayo ||
sn12.65:2.12: viññāṇe kho sati nāmarūpaṃ hoti viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpanti || || 7
sn12.65:2.14: Kimhi nu kho sati viññāṇaṃ hoti kiṃpaccayā viññāṇanti || || 8
sn12.65:2.15: Tassa mayham bhikkhave yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo || ||
sn12.65:2.16: Nāmarūpe kho sati viññāṇaṃ hoti nāmarūpapaccayā viññāṇanti || 9
sn12.65:3.2: Paccudāvattati kho idaṃ viññāṇaṃ nāmarūpamhā nāparaṃ gacchati ||
sn12.65:3.3: ettāvatā jīyetha vā jāyetha vā māyetha vā cavetha vā upapajjetha vā yad idam nāmarūpapaccayā viññāṇaṃ ||
sn12.65:3.7: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 10
sn12.65:3.8: Samudayo samudayo ti kho me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi || || 11
sn12.65:4.2: Kiṃhi nu kho asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti ||
sn12.65:4.4: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.65:4.5: Jātiyā kho asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti ||
sn12.65:4.8: Kimhi nu kho asati jāti na hoti
sn12.65:4.17: Tassa mayham bhikkhave yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.65:4.18: viññāṇe kho asati nāmarupaṃ na hoti ||
sn12.65:5.2: Kimhi nu kho asati viññāṇaṃ na hoti ||
sn12.65:5.4: Tassa mayham bhikkhave yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.65:5.5: nāmarūpe kho asati viññāṇaṃ na hoti
sn12.65:6.2: Adhigato kho myāyaṃ maggobodhāya yad idaṃ
sn12.65:6.7: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 18
sn12.65:6.8: Nirodho nirodhoti kho me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi || || 19
sn12.65:7.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso araññe pavane caramāno passeyya purāṇam maggam purāṇañjasaṃ pubbakehi manussehi anuyātaṃ ||
sn12.65:7.3: tam anugacchanto passeyya purāṇaṃ nagaraṃ purāṇam rājadhāniṃ pubbakehi manussehi ajjhāvutthaṃ ārāmasampannaṃ vanasampannaṃ pokkharaṇisampannam uddāpavantaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ || || 20
sn12.65:7.4: Atha kho so bhikkhave puriso rañño vā rājamahāmattassa vā ārocceyya || ||
sn12.65:7.5: Yagghe bhante jāneyyāsi || aham addasam araññe pavane caramāno purāṇaṃ maggaṃ purāṇañjasaṃ pubbākehi manussehi anuyātam tam anuggacchiṃ ||
sn12.65:7.6: tam anugacchanto addasaṃ purāṇam nagaraṃ purāṇaṃ rājadhāniṃ pubbakehi maṇussehi ajjhāvutthaṃ ārāmasampannaṃ vanasampannaṃ pokkharaṇisampannam uddāpavantaṃ ramaṇīyam ||
sn12.65:7.8: Atha kho bhikkhave rājā vā rājamahāmatto vā taṃ nagaram māpeyya ||
sn12.65:7.9: tad assa nagaram aparena samayena iddhaṃ ceva phitaṃ ca bahujanam ākiṇṇamanussam vuddhivepullappattaṃ || ||
sn12.65:7.10: Evam eva khvāham bhikkhave addasaṃ purāṇaṃ maggaṃ purāṇañjasaṃ pubbakehi sammāsambuddhehi anuyātaṃ || || 22
sn12.65:8.1: Katamo ca so bhikkhave purāṇamaggo purāṇañjaso pubbakehi sammāsambuddhehi anuyāto || ||
sn12.65:8.2: Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo || seyyathāpi
sn12.65:8.4: Ayaṃ kho so bhikkhave purāṇamaggo purāṇañjaso pubbakehi sammāsaṃbuddhehi anuyāto || || Tam anugacchiṃ ||
sn12.65:8.24: Tad abhiññāya ācikkhiṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānam upāsikānam ||
sn12.65:8.25: tayidam bhikkhave brahmacariyam iddhaṃ ceva phītaṃ ca vitthārikaṃ bahujaññaṃ puthubhūtam yāvadeva manussehi suppakāsitanti || ||
